A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 23-page ResT paper, including Appendices A–D. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical material on pages 2–23; first-page differences concern only date/version information.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C report original BFCL and API-Bank experiments, component ablations, training dynamics, and token-entropy analysis.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C retain the same original benchmark results, ablations, training dynamics, and token-entropy analysis.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 and Appendix B retain identical rule-based rewards, entropy-informed token weighting, curriculum updates, and optimization procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions train on ToolACE, masked Hammer, and XLAM and evaluate on BFCL and API-Bank. The single-turn, multi-turn, missing-function, missing-parameter, long-context, and API-Bank difficulty-level coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Base, SFT, TSFT, RSFT, GRPO, and SFT+GRPO remain in the same corresponding comparisons. Reference-model comparisons in Table 1 and Figure 2 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The 4,000-example training mixture, dialogue preprocessing, evaluated model configurations, scoring procedures, and best-score selection remain unchanged. Table 2 retains API-Bank sample counts of 399, 67, and 131.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the same dynamic-reward, CoT-gradient, and curriculum ablations. Training dynamics in Figure 3 and regional entropy analysis in Appendix C's Figure 4 are identical.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting in the tables and plots is identical. No repeated-run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates, or significance procedures are added, removed, or revised.

E6.justification: All results in Tables 1–6 and Figures 2–4 are unchanged. For example, ResT retains 50.38% BFCL multi-turn overall accuracy for Qwen3-4B-2507 (Table 1) and 62.81% API-Bank overall accuracy for Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (Table 5).

T1.justification: Section 3.1's lemmas and theorems, Appendix A's assumptions and proofs, and Appendix D's GRPO formulation are identical. No mathematical definitions, bounds, or derivations change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same entropy–stability argument, ResT contribution, and benchmark-superiority claims, with identical scope and stated performance advantages.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning training stability, longer responses, generalization, and applicability across model families remain identical. No substantive limitations or qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: Section 4.1's data-construction details and Appendix B's algorithm pseudocode are unchanged. No implementation, hyperparameter, hardware, or code/data access information is added or revised.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning relative to previous tool-use and reinforcement-learning methods, and all 41 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: The title-page date changes from September 29, 2025 to February 5, 2026. The arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 26 Sep 2025 to v2 dated 4 Feb 2026; prose, terminology, and section structure otherwise remain identical.

P2.justification: All four figures, six tables, captions, and their placement are unchanged. The first-page date/version text updates do not alter the document layout.

improvement.justification: The revision only updates first-page date/version information. Scientific content, empirical evidence, proofs, reproducibility details, explanations, and visual presentation remain unchanged, including throughout the appendices, leaving overall paper quality materially unchanged.
